position_caps.caps_note: Mirrors momentum equity caps where they still fit active trading. max_concurrent_positions=8. max_new_trades_per_day=8 spam cap. Tech mega-cap sleeve cap retained. Rule v3 2026-10-06: max_new_trades_per_day=8 counts BUY entries only; exits (trend break / ATR stop) are never capped. Buys under min_order_usd ($1,000) are skipped as dust and use no cap slot. Rule v4 2026-10-06: open positions under min_order_usd are dust; they do not count toward max_concurrent_positions and are sold as uncapped exits (liquidate_dust_positions). Rule v5 2026-10-06: reentry_cooldown_bars=4 (1 hour) blocks re-buying a ticker after any SELL of it (Freqtrade CooldownPeriod style). Rule v6 2026-10-08: entry_open_delay_minutes=30 blocks new equity BUY entries from 09:30 until 10:00 ET (entry_skip_opening_window; no cap slot). Exits still allowed any time during RTH. Crypto unaffected.

rebalance.note: Live scan+book on 15m bars during US RTH (driven by market_hours_refresh / run_active.py). Exits on EMA bearish cross or ATR stop; entries on bullish cross/state into open slots. Never mix into weekly momentum ranks.
